meta.name: apollo-incident-runbook
meta.description:
Apollo.io incident response procedures.
Use when handling Apollo outages, debugging production issues,
or responding to integration failures.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo incident", "apollo outage",
"apollo down", "apollo production issue", "apollo emergency".

copy.tagline: 按手册排查 Apollo 故障并响应中断
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护 Apollo 相关服务,需要标准事故处理流程。
copy.tagline_en: Follow a runbook to debug Apollo outages and respond to disruptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Apollo services and need a reliable incident response procedure.

howto.what: Apollo.io出现故障时，Claude按流程处理：事件分类→快速诊断命令→按严重程度分级的响应→断路器实现→事后报告模板，并按升级规则自动提示下一步。
howto.when: 当你提到“apollo incident”“apollo outage”等关键词，或要求处理Apollo中断、生产问题、集成故障时触发。

say.text: Apollo outage，请按故障响应流程处理
say.note: Claude会启动事件分类和升级
Claude执行对应严重程度的步骤

say.text: 给我Apollo集成故障的诊断命令
say.note: Claude输出诊断命令和断路器建议

howto.what_en: When Apollo.io has an incident, Claude follows the runbook: classify the incident, provide quick diagnosis commands, severity-based response procedures, circuit breaker implementation, and a post-incident template. It also applies escalation rules automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'apollo incident', 'apollo outage', or when handling Apollo outages, debugging production issues, or responding to integration failures.

say_en.text: Apollo outage, please run the incident response procedure.
Apollo production issue, respond as P2.
Give me quick diagnostic commands for the Apollo integration failure.
say_en.note: Claude outputs commands and circuit breaker suggestions.
